interaction.content: Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I keep thinking I'm weak-minded.
That's a good time to reflect on yourself whenever you feel that way.
Yes, I do reflect on myself and wonder why I am so weak-hearted and how I can be stronger.
What does it mean to you specifically to be strong-minded?
It means to be able to recover quickly when you are hurt or disappointed, and to be able to try new things without fear.
It sounds like you have a clear goal for personal growth.
Yes, so I'm trying to figure out what practical steps to take to make this goal happen.
The process of considering practical steps also seems to be part of the growth.
I've actually been trying to see people a little bit lately.
I see, so actively participating in social situations will help build confidence.
I'm looking forward to it as well.
When you're trying to meet people, what activities are you most interested in?
I like reading books, so I'm thinking of joining a book club.
Joining a book club sounds like a good direction for a new beginning.
That makes me feel a little bit better.
Sharing our experiences and broadening our understanding of each other is an important element of growing.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I have lost a lot of interest in things around me. I don't have the same enthusiasm for meeting friends or starting new things as I used to.
You've been involved in a lot of things passionately.
Yes, I did. But now I struggle to find meaning in anything I start.
Can you share what triggered that emotion in the first place?
I don't know when exactly, actually. Everything just started to feel unimportant to me.
I see, you feel like many aspects of life have become unimportant.
Yes, it is. Just getting through the day feels like a task.
It sounds like all of your daily activities have become a burden.
That's accurate. I feel like all of my daily activities are a huge burden.
You said that the activities are feeling like a big burden.
Yes, I feel like I have no motivation for anything and just feel overwhelmed.
What are some ways to reduce this burden?
I want to start with something small that I can accomplish.
I see, you want to feel a sense of accomplishment from something small.
Yes, and I want to find those things that give me a sense of accomplishment.
You want to find work that gives you a sense of accomplishment.
Hi, what have you been thinking about lately?
Hi. I've been thinking a lot about my relationship with my mom lately. She often says things that make me feel like she resents me, and it's been a big source of stress for me.
It sounds like you're feeling a lot of stress due to your relationship with your mom.
Yeah, it's hardest when my mom blames me, especially when she's angry.
It sounds like you're feeling overwhelmed with the responsibility of taking on your mom's anger directly.
That's so true. Whenever my mom blames me, I can't help but doubt myself.
What would you like to see improve in your relationship with your mom?
I hope that there will be a relationship of respect and understanding between my mom and me.
Your desire to have a relationship with your mom that is based on mutual respect and understanding is very important.
I want to have the courage to express my thoughts to my mom, even if it's just a little bit.
In what way would you like to express your thoughts to your mom?
I want to talk about the problems that are arising in our relationship.
I see, talking about the problems openly might help improve the relationship.
Yes, I would like to have an honest conversation to clear up any misunderstandings and work towards improving our relationship.
When you're ready for an honest conversation, what's the first topic you want to talk about?
I want to start by making sure we're aligned on our expectations for each other.
I see, trying to align our expectations of each other could be a good first step in communication.
Hi, can we share what happened recently that affected you the most psychologically?
After I failed the civil service exam, I started to feel very isolated in the process of preparing for the exam again.
I bet there was a lot of emotion that came out in that process.
Yes, especially since everyone around me seems to be on their way and I feel like I'm the only one left behind.
You feel like you're falling behind compared to the people around you.
That's right. I can't help but constantly feel my situation is pathetic even if I try not to compare.
You are constantly comparing yourself to others, and as a result, you feel that your situation is insignificant.
When I feel that way, I feel even more alone and powerless.
Loneliness and hardship are coming from such thoughts.
Yes, so the feeling of being alone intensifies.
I see that you are struggling with feeling more and more alone.
Yes, I also feel like this situation is making me more exhausted.
I see, you're feeling that your tired and drained mind is getting worse in this situation.
Yes, I want to get away from all this burden and pressure more than anything.
You feel a strong need to get away from the burden and pressure.
Hi, what emotion are you feeling most often right now?
I'm sorry, but I feel frustrated and helpless most often.
Thank you for sharing those feelings with me.
I always make the same mistakes and I'm disappointed in myself for not changing.
I can understand your frustration with the ongoing mistakes.
Yeah, I think that disappointment makes me feel even more lethargic.
I see that you are feeling that disappointment is leading to lethargy.
I think I should try to understand myself more.
What a courageous act of trying to understand yourself.
Thank you. I think the more I understand, the better I can move forward.
What methods would you like to try to understand yourself better?
I want to analyze why I procrastinate first.
I like that you're thinking about analyzing the causes of procrastination, it shows a willingness to address the issue.
After identifying the cause, I want to try to reduce procrastination by achieving small goals.
I am impressed that you have a specific plan to address the problem and are willing to take action.
I started to believe that I could make changes gradually, even if they were small goals.
You're starting to believe in incremental change through small goal achievement.
Hello, what thoughts have been occupying your mind most often lately?
The stress and loneliness I get from my relationships with people is what's on my mind the most.
It sounds like you're struggling with how to relate to people and how to be in those relationships.
You're right, that struggle made me reflect on myself and decide to find a new hobby.
Is there a change or feeling you would like to get from your new hobby?
Yes, I want to reduce stress a little by starting a new hobby, and I want to spend my time alone well.
What do you want to feel when you spend time alone?
I want to feel satisfied and happy with myself.
You want to feel satisfied and happy with yourself.
Yes, and I want to take some time to myself to better understand my feelings.
What activities do you think would be helpful for you when you want to better understand your emotions?
Maybe an activity like reading a book or writing something would help.
Which activity would you like to try first, reading or writing?
I want to try writing first.
I see you wanting to explore your feelings through writing.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
My heart is heavy every day, and I have great worries about the future.
It's an important process to share like this even when your heart is heavy and you have a lot of worries.
So, I get depressed and anxious easily over trivial things.
You said you get depressed and anxious over trivial things.
Yes, and it's affecting my studies, my life, and my health.
Anxiety and depression are affecting your studies, life, and health.
I want to make this situation better, even if it's just a little bit.
I would love to hear what changes you would like to experience in this situation.
I want to learn how to manage stress.
You want to learn how to manage stress.
Yes, I think that's the first step for me right now.
You're already thinking towards transformation.
I think I'll be happier if I give myself more time to relax.
You think that if you give yourself a break, you'll be able to feel happy.
I feel a little lighter now that I have this thought.
I'm glad you're finding it helpful and that it's making you feel lighter.
Hello, what made you decide to visit this time?
Hi, I've been finding myself not getting things done that I should have been doing lately and I've been feeling so frustrated.
I can imagine the frustration you must have felt in that situation.
Yes, it's having a big impact on my daily life.
It sounds like you are feeling quite affected by your daily life and the burden it is causing you.
Yeah, it's a lot of pressure, and I want to address it, but I don't know how.
You have the will to solve, but you are not finding the way.
Yes, I really don't know where or how to start.
You're at a loss for where to start.
Yes, it would be helpful if you could get some insight into that.
I see you have a desire to gain insight.
Yes, I'd like to understand your situation a bit more.
Your effort to understand the client's situation specifically is an important first step.
I'm getting stronger and stronger in my thinking to improve this situation.
You have a strong will to improve things.
Yes, that's why I came here.
Thank you for coming here and telling us about your current situation.
Hi, what's something that happened recently that left you feeling nostalgic?
I feel heavy about my chosen major.
So you must be doing a lot of thinking about the field you're studying now.
Yes, I'm not sure if I'm really interested
Can you tell me more about what part you are not sure about?
I was interested in design but chose tourism due to practical issues.
Now you're struggling between reality and interest.
That's true. I also regret the choices I made to give up on my interests in front of the wall of reality.
You have the courage to face your feelings, even in the midst of regret and struggle.
As much as I want to think that, it's really hard.
What help or advice would you find useful in overcoming the situation right now?
I want to find out what I really want and how to go about getting there.
I see, trying to discover the client's longing would be the starting point of the journey.
Only, I find it overwhelming to even find a starting point.
I see, finding a starting point is challenging for you.
Yes, I think it's because I keep feeling stuck and not sure where to go.
I understand the feeling of having a big problem and not knowing where to turn.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I don't know what to do these days. I know I should study, but it's so hard to start.
Can you tell me what specific reasons you have for finding it difficult to start studying?
I can't concentrate, and I feel anxious when I try to start something.
The situation of not being able to concentrate and the anxiety are constantly blocking you.
Yes, and it makes it even harder because I feel like I'm letting my family down.
It sounds like you're struggling with the pressure of meeting your family's expectations and the fear of not living up to them.
True, but these days the pressure seems to drive you into ever deeper corners.
What have you tried to do to reduce that pressure?
I haven't really tried anything specific yet.
What methods would you like to try when faced with that pressure?
I want to set small goals and achieve them little by little.
You want to set small goals and achieve them.
Yes, I think that would help me work through my anxiety.
It sounds like your client's method for overcoming anxiety is already becoming a feasible plan.
Hi, what's new with you?
Hi, I'm actually going through a pretty rough time with my parents lately.
That situation is having a big impact on you.
Yes, you're right. This situation is weighing heavily on me.
It sounds like your relationship with your parents is quite difficult for you psychologically.
I really do. I feel like I'm constantly at odds with my parents, and I don't feel understood.
It seems that the misunderstanding caused by the conflict of opinions is deepening.
Yes, that's accurate. It feels like I can't communicate my opinions or feelings without being shut down.
It sounds like you're feeling quite overwhelmed with the lack of communication.
Indeed. The lack of communication is making me even more frustrated.
It sounds like you're feeling frustrated with the lack of communication.
Yes, I'm ready for a change too.
I'm impressed with your efforts to change.
I want to do something to improve this situation too.
It seems like you're trying to find a direction.
Hi, what thoughts have been filling your mind lately?
I often feel left behind when I see the achievements of others.
That must be quite a heavy emotion.
Yes, indeed, I feel so insignificant.
It sounds like you're comparing yourself to others and feeling less than.
Right, that comparison makes me feel even smaller.
Comparison can sometimes be a prison that keeps us stuck.
I guess I should try to get out of the comparison.
It can't have been easy to make the decision to stop comparing, so I applaud you for that.
Thank you. But I'm stuck on putting that decision into action.
Any methods you would like to try to stop the comparison?
I'm just going to focus on the job at hand.
It's a very positive attitude to try to focus on the work at hand.
Yes, I want to focus on my own growth rather than comparing myself to others.
Your choice to focus on your own growth will be an important step.
Hi, what thoughts or feelings have been weighing on your mind the most lately?
I often feel bad when I hang out with people.
I see. I guess hanging out with people is different now.
Yes, I feel like I don't have energy anymore when I'm around people.
You don't get as much energy as you used to when you're around people.
Yes, but I don't know how to do that.
I see that you are looking for a solution to your current situation where you are not finding energy when you are around people.
Yes, I want to find a solution.
So you're in the process of figuring out how to solve it.
Right, I'm trying to figure out which way to go.
I can feel the effort to move forward despite the struggles.
I want to think of small things I can do first to improve this situation.
I see, you're trying to come up with ways to try on your own to improve the situation.
Yes, I would like to explore ways to feel more confident and comfortable around people.
I see you're looking for ways to feel more confident and comfortable.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I've been feeling very disconnected from the people around me lately, and that's been on my mind a lot.
I can imagine that situation isn't easy for you. The distance you feel from people can be heavy on the heart.
Yes, exactly. I used to be somewhat positive about hanging out with people, but now it feels like an effort.
The pressure to blend in has grown.
I feel like the pressure I feel is ultimately going to make me withdraw from people even more.
The burden is making the relationship more difficult, affecting it to drift apart.
Yes, but I don't mind that, which makes it more complicated.
I'd love to hear why you don't feel that burden is a bad thing.
When I have a burden, I distance myself from people because I think that will reduce the stress I'm under.
I see you've experienced that distancing yourself from people reduces stress.
Yeah, those experiences make me feel like more of a weirdo.
I can see how the process of finding ways to manage the stress from the distance from people can be challenging.
Yes, even trying to handle it my way, the continued distance is weighing on me.
Have you ever thought about reducing the distance?
I'll admit, sometimes I think about it.
I'm curious to know what methods you have in mind when trying to reduce the distance.
I'm not sure how to do that yet.
It's the process of finding ways to change things a little bit at a time that matters.
Yeah, I think that process is necessary.
Through that process, you will find the right solution for yourself.
Hi, what challenge are you facing?

I've been having a hard time adjusting to my new academy. In the academy, we have to ask the teacher when we take a test or if we have a question we don't know, but I get so nervous every time I have to ask, and my body gets stiff.
I see, you feel burdened by the activities required in the new environment.
Yeah, I think that's definitely true. Especially for me, I take longer than other friends to get used to new environments.
I see, you feel like you need your own pace to adjust to the new environment.
Yes, and it's really hard for me to speak up when I want to ask or do something.
When you feel difficulty in making vocal sounds, what do you think?
I just feel like it's all my fault, and I shouldn't be like this.
It sounds like you're feeling a lot of responsibility for yourself, while also experiencing pressure to change.
Yes, but I feel pressured to change and at the same time I want to get out of this situation.
You have shown courage to seek change even in the face of difficult circumstances. That is truly admirable.
Thank you, that's great to hear.
What first step do you want to take to get out of this situation?
I don't know how yet, but I want to try to do something, even if it's small.
You're willing to try one small thing.
Yes, I'd like to start with anything and work through it.
What small attempt would you like to make?
It would be nice to try a short greeting or a brief conversation before asking the teacher a question.
You would like to say a short greeting or a brief conversation before asking your teacher a question.
Yes, that would help me relax a little.
What do you expect to feel from that first greeting or conversation?
I think I will feel a little more comfortable with the teacher and naturally questions will be easier.
How do you think you can make it easier to feel familiar with your teacher?
Maybe if you talked to me first or showed interest in me I would feel more comfortable.
You think that if your teacher would talk to you or show you attention, you would feel more comfortable.
Yes, even such casual interactions would be great for me.
What other ways do you think we can feel that interaction?
I will try to express small interest or praise to my teacher, starting with myself.
I see, you would like to express a small act of kindness or appreciation to your teacher, starting with yourself.
Yes, I think that would help improve my relationship with my teacher.
I see, you think it would help improve your relationship with your teacher.
Hello, is there anything you've been struggling with lately?
Hi, I feel like my life is becoming repetitive and boring lately, and I keep feeling disillusioned with life.
I can imagine that must have been a difficult situation for you to go through.
Yes, it's very hard.
What activities or moments in your daily life do you find to be even a little bit mood-lifting?
I feel a little better when I go for a walk or read a book.
Do you often go for walks or read?
Yes, I try it whenever my mind is troubled.
You find solace in walks and reading when your mind is troubled.
Still not much better though.
Are you interested in any other activities besides the walks and reading you currently do?
I'm also interested in listening to music or drawing.
Are you ready to start listening to music or drawing?
I haven't tried it yet, but I'd like to start working my way through it.
I see, you're willing to try and find new joys through music or painting.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I keep thinking that my relationship with a friend I used to be close to has changed a lot.
It must be hard for you to accept that change.
It is. It's very heartbreaking that it seems like we can't go back to the way things were.
I understand that you are feeling a deep sense of loss due to the changes in your friendship.
Yes, that's right. I'm sad because I lost my best friend, the one I trusted and relied on the most.
I can hear the sadness in your voice as you share the loss of a friend you trusted and relied on.
I'm wondering how I can improve my relationship with that friend, or if there's a way to make new friends.
I see, you are having a lot of thoughts about improving your relationships or making new connections.
Yes, I do. I really don't know how to approach it.
I see that you are feeling stuck and unsure about how to rebuild or reestablish relationships.
I want to solve the situation in my own way.
You have a strong need to deal with things in your own way.
Yes, I want to regain my confidence.
It sounds like wanting to regain your confidence is a really important motivation for you.
Hi, what has been bothering you the most lately?
I get home from work and I just don't want to do anything.
I can see how that would be the case after a long day at work.
Yes, when I come home, I just lie down and waste time.
You become less interested in doing anything other than resting.
I see, I'm not finding anything of interest either.
I see, you have a curiosity for a new hobby or activity, but you haven't found it yet.
Yes, I am. I'm curious, but I don't know what to be curious about.
You are curious but have not found an object of interest.
Exactly, I'm at a loss as to where to direct that curiosity.
Do you have any hobbies that you enjoy doing in the past?
I used to love drawing when I was younger.
Would you like to try drawing again?
I'd like to, but I'm not sure where to start.
It sounds like you still have a love for painting, but you're struggling to find direction on where to start.
Yes, that's accurate. It's hard to get a sense of direction at the beginning.
What style or subject matter are you most interested in when it comes to drawing?
I'm interested in painting landscapes.
What kind of landscape would you like to paint?
I want to draw places I have seen while traveling.
It sounds like you want to draw the places you have seen while traveling, to relive the memories and express them through art.
Hi, is there anything on your mind lately?
Hi, I've been having a hard time lately. It's because of something a friend said to me that really stuck with me.
That one line still stuck with you.
Yes, it was really unexpected, and the comment made me feel extremely nervous for the rest of the day.
Can you explain what that meant to you?
Actually the words themselves weren't too bad. It was just that I wasn't ready to admit fault and move on.
You were not prepared at that time to hear that, so your heart was more greatly stirred.
Yes, exactly. I was just so hurt by something that would normally be no big deal.
You were really hurt by something that normally wouldn't bother you.
I see. I can understand how that would increase the tension or anxiety you're feeling.
That must have increased the tension and anxiety after that.
Yes, I tried to get out of that situation, but it wasn't easy.
I see you've tried to get out of that situation.
Yes, but it didn't do much good.
I'm sorry to hear that despite your efforts, things haven't been getting better for you.
Yes, so I want to find a way to feel a little better.
You want to improve your current situation.
Yes, I'm hoping for some improvement.
I can see that you are willing to try to turn the situation around positively despite the current difficulties.
Right, I was thinking of changing the situation.
Your thoughts will play a major role in changing the situation.
Hi, what has been weighing on your mind lately?
Hi, I'm always nervous in front of people and I'm shy. It's a burden on my mind.
It sounds like you have a significant amount of anxiety about social situations.
Yes, it's a real feeling of nervousness, especially when you're around people you don't know or when you're put in a new environment.
In what situations or activities do you feel a little more comfortable?
In fact, when you are focused on something or doing a hobby, your mind naturally relaxes.
So how can you extend the relaxation you feel when you're focused or engaged in a hobby to other parts of your life?
Well, I can try to give myself positive messages and try to get used to the new environment little by little.
I can see how trying to get used to a new environment can make you feel more confident than before.
I think so too. I'd like to reduce this tension by trying little by little.
I see that you are thinking of ways to reduce your tension and your willingness to quietly put it into action is very good.
I really feel like I can get better even if it's just a little bit.
I hope you're feeling a little better.
Yes, I also look forward to positive outcomes as I work towards change.
It is impressive that you are willing to make changes and expect positive results.
Thank you. I will try to believe in myself and challenge myself one by one.
The experiences you will gain from trusting yourself and taking the leap will definitely help.
Hi, how has your mind been lately?
Hi, I've been feeling really confused and anxious lately.
Thank you for sharing that anxiety for a moment.
So I don't know how to move forward with this mess either.
I can see you're struggling to find your way in the chaos.
Yes, it's so hard to decide exactly where to go.
In the midst of that difficulty, what is most important to you?
The most important thing for me is my desire to continue to grow in the field related to Japanese language.
You mentioned your desire to grow in the field related to Japanese language.
Yes, I do. But my current grades make it seem unlikely that I will achieve my goal.
I see, you're feeling some difficulty in achieving your goals.
Right, so I'm stuck on how to do that.
It sounds like you have a desire to grow, but the path to your goals seems daunting in your current situation.
Exactly. I'm working on how to find my interest again and be able to focus on it now.
I see you're trying to figure out how to find interest and focus again.
Hi, what is the biggest challenge you are facing in your life lately?
It's getting harder and harder to face people.
I think I'm starting to feel like communicating with people is a burden.
Yes, so continuing school life, going to the academy, feels very burdensome.
Interpersonal relationships in your daily life are weighing on you.
Yes, I think this situation is making me feel more isolated.
The strain from interpersonal relationships is increasing your sense of isolation.
So I want to get better at least a little bit.
You sound like you want to feel a little better.
Yes, I'd like to try to push myself further.
Can you tell me in what way you want to try?
I think first I want to make sure that I'm not avoiding people, but I'm creating opportunities to face them little by little.
You're interested in trying to take on the challenge of facing people a little bit.
Yes, and I hope that in the process I can understand myself better.
What changes in self-understanding do you expect to come out of that process?
I hope you gain some insight into why I feel this way, and how you can overcome these fears.
It sounds like you have a strong desire to gain insight into yourself through your experiences.
Hi, what thoughts or feelings have been bothering you lately?
I have trouble expressing my feelings, which makes it difficult for me to connect with others.
What do you find most challenging about expressing your emotions?
I feel like my emotions are all over my face, and even if I try to hide them, people around me can easily tell.
What is the reaction of people around you when they notice your feelings?
I smile and say nothing is wrong, but I think they can tell from my expression and demeanor.
It sounds like you feel frustrated that you are trying to hide your true feelings, but others are able to see through it.
Yes, exactly. That's why I want to handle my emotions more maturely.
So what approaches are you considering in your process of wanting to mature your emotions?
I don't know yet. I just want to start by acknowledging and understanding my feelings.
I see, you want to acknowledge and understand the emotions to lead to the client's growth.
Yes, I want to believe that I can change through such attempts.
It's great that you're trying to understand your feelings.
And I want to improve my way of communicating with people around me.
Your willingness to improve your communication will be an opportunity to make the relationship more positive.
Hello, what events or experiences have impacted your life recently?

Hello. I was aiming for a job in a public institution. In the process, I went through several failures and had a hard time mentally. I eventually gave up on my goal and it took me a long time to recover from being unemployed for a long time.
It sounds like the journey towards public sector employment has been quite mentally taxing for you.
That's right, it was a huge burden. But now I'm trying to get back to work, and when I try to write a self-introduction, I feel like I'm suffocating.
Starting the writing of the resume is becoming another challenge for the client.
Yes, that's accurate. I don't know what to do in this situation right now.
What part of the process do you find most challenging?
I really feel aversion to studying and preparing in the same way as before.
The old preparation process is causing a strong feeling of rejection in you.
What I feel averse to, exactly, is that I don't want to do the kind of studying that feels meaningless, like it did before.
You're feeling a strong sense of resentment towards studying, which feels meaningless.
Yes, but I think I've changed a little bit over time. I'm starting to feel like I want to make a fresh start.
I wonder what makes you want to start fresh.
It's hard but I want to get better than now.
What specifically do you mean by wanting to be better than you are now?
It's about trying again, even if it's a public sector job or a contract.
I see you want to try again.
Hi, what thoughts or feelings have been on your mind the most lately?
I feel like I can't do anything well, and I always feel like I'm falling behind.
Those feelings can be so hard.
So I tend to avoid situations where I have to be in front of people, and I think this makes the cycle worse.
You feel like you lack confidence, but you also want to get out of the situation that causes it.
Yes, I want to get out of those situations and get my confidence back a little bit.
You have the will to regain your confidence.
Yes, I have a desire to change now.
The seed of change is sprouting in your heart.
I'm going to start small with what I can do.
You're starting small.
Yes, I will try to talk to people around me more often.
That's great that you're trying to improve your relationship through communication.
I believe that if we try this way, we will change little by little.
You believe that through effort, you will change.
Hi, what's been on your mind lately?

Hi, I'm actually interested in animation and I've been preparing for animation high school since middle school. But recently, after failing the entrance exam, I've been having a hard time focusing on my daily life and feeling depressed.
You've been working towards your goals with passion all this time.
Yes, really. But it's so hard when you fail and it feels like all your efforts were for nothing.
It sounds like you're feeling a sense of loss because your efforts so far have felt futile.
Yeah, I think I lost a lot of trust in myself as well as the loss.
I understand that you have been working hard and have a passion for animation, but you have been experiencing failures and losing confidence and hope.
True, but I want to start over.
When you think about starting again, what is the first thing that comes to mind?
I want to prove to myself that I can be successful in other areas of my life.
You want to rediscover your own beliefs about your abilities and challenge yourself in a new field.
Yes, I want to rebuild my shattered confidence, and set new goals based on what I've learned from my failures.
It sounds like you're eager to learn from your failures and set new goals.
I want to use failure as an opportunity to grow further.
It's impressive how resilient and positive you are about your growth.
Thank you, I will try to live a life of taking on challenges without fear of failure from now on.
You have a great determination to be ready for new challenges without fear of failure.
I'm going to take the lessons learned from this experience and try to move forward once again.
It is very positive that you are determined to take a new path with the experience as a lesson.
Hi, what thoughts have been occupying your mind the most lately?
I'm struggling a lot with studies and relationships.
I see that you are experiencing difficulties with your studies and relationships.
Yes, especially studying, I can't get good grades no matter how hard I try.
I see, you feel that your grades are not meeting your expectations despite your efforts.
That's true. I work really hard, but my grades don't go up much.
I see, you're working hard but not seeing much improvement in your grades.
Right, and I keep getting hurt in relationships.
The hurt you are experiencing in your relationships is becoming a very heavy situation for you, along with the stress you are under with your studies.
